N8.drift_interpretation: Same 125 prompts, same SFT adapter, same base model. 0.4pp discrepancy is within decoding-config / seed noise; no gate was set on no_api (only oracle_full had the +/-0.02 sanity gate, which PASSED at 0.498 vs 0.498).

table_bm25.bm25_delta_vs_noapi_note: exp_011 metrics: delta_vs_noapi_N2=0.0916, N4=0.0629, N8=0.122 — these deltas were computed against exp_006 baseline (N8 uses 0.025, not 0.021). Paper caption currently says '+9.1pp N=2, +12.6pp N=8' — the +12.6pp uses the new 0.021 baseline (0.147 - 0.021 = 0.126); the +9.1pp uses 0.203 - 0.112 = 0.091. Consistent with the new N=8 value.

split_architecture_clarification.phase1d_v2_test_split_design: Canonical phase1d_v2 test split is structured as three fixed per-N partitions, NOT a single pool subsampled per N. Exp_006 original eval already used n_prompts = {N2:251, N4:131, N8:125}. Exp_016's 'n=125 subset' is NOT a subsample — it is the full N=8 partition.
split_architecture_clarification.implication_for_reviewer_C1_concern: The apparent 'split drift' between N=2/N=4 (0.112/0.084 from exp_006) and N=8 (0.021 from exp_016) is NOT caused by N=8 using a smaller subset. N=8 has always been 125 prompts. The only difference is that sed_worker_3 replaced exp_006's own N=8 number (0.025) with exp_016's re-evaluation (0.021) on the identical 125 prompts. The 0.004 drift is same-split, cross-run decoding noise, not subset drift.

branch_a_recommendation.minimum_fix: Add a footnote to Table 3 (tab:oracle_api) and Table BM25 (tab:bm25) captions clarifying: (a) each N column uses its own fixed phase1d_v2 test partition with n_prompts = {N2:251, N4:131, N8:125} — these are canonical per-N splits, not random subsamples; (b) the N=8 honest_search baseline (0.021) is from exp_016's re-evaluation on the identical 125 prompts, chosen to match the paired-bootstrap decomposition in Table tab:redaction_bootstrap_ci; exp_006's canonical run on the same 125 prompts reports 0.025 (0.4pp within cross-run noise, within the pre-registered +/-0.02 sanity tolerance).
branch_a_recommendation.status_of_existing_disclosure: Appendix app:exp006_full_test already discloses the 0.021 vs 0.025 N=8 same-split re-eval difference. Recommendation is to also mention the per-N prompt counts (251/131/125) in the Table 3 caption so reviewers do not incorrectly infer subsampling.

branch_b_recommendation_NOT_APPLICABLE: Branch B would require re-running exp_006 N=2/N=4 on a 125-prompt subset OR rolling N=8 back to 0.025. Neither is needed: the 125-prompt N=8 IS the full N=8 split, and N=2/N=4 are already on their respective full splits.
